title: Correct AB potential difference
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates V_AB = W_AB / q = 200 V.

title: Correct BC potential difference
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates V_BC = W_BC / q = 300 V.

title: Correct CA potential difference
description: Essential: Student correctly finds V_CA = - (V_AB + V_BC) = -500 V or V_AC = 500 V.

title: Potentials relative to B
description: Important: Student correctly uses V_B = 0 to find V_A = V_AB = 200 V and V_C = -V_BC = -300 V.

title: Potential energy calculation
description: Important: Student correctly calculates U = qφ for points A and C, yielding -6e-4 J and 9e-4 J.

title: Sign handling for work
description: Important: Student correctly interprets that work done by the electric field is used in ΔV = W/q, not the work done against it.

title: Additivity of potential
description: Optional: Student explicitly states or uses that potential differences add along a path (V_AC = V_AB + V_BC).

title: Sign confusion in ΔV
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns signs to potential differences, e.g., confusing V_AB with V_BA or misusing the sign of q.

title: Unit consistency
description: Pitfall: Student fails to maintain consistent units (Volts for potential, Joules for energy) or omits units.
